prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity product concept for a simple iPhone to Sony TV live drawing app. Inspired by Inko's clean white canvas, colorful expressive ink and small floating tools, but original interface, no Inko branding, no collaboration. Simplified Chinese UI. Consistent warm white, graphite text, blue accent, colorful small swatches, restrained Apple-like native controls. Product working title 随手画. Only one phone and one television. No Apple Pencil shown. Draw with finger. Shared artwork throughout: simple hand-drawn orange sun above two blue hills with a small green tree on white, same proportions on both devices. Landscape drawing canvas 16:9 never stretch or crop. QR codes are illustrative placeholders. Asset: wide polished mobile UI presentation sheet, three clearly separated phone screens, on pale gray background with large whitespace and crisp legible Chinese. Left portrait iPhone pairing home, heading 连接电视, short 扫描电视上的二维码, primary 扫码连接, secondary 输入配对码, tiny 无需注册. Center portrait iPhone camera scan screen heading 扫码配对, QR viewfinder and caption 将电视二维码放入框内. Right and largest landscape iPhone active drawing screen, large white 16:9 canvas with sun hills tree; slim top bar 随手画, green dot 已连接电视, undo redo and export icon; compact floating bottom toolbar pen, marker, eraser, five color circles, stroke size. Small external captions 01 连接 / 02 扫码 / 03 横屏绘图. Beautiful real usable spacious UI, no extra features, no gradient blobs. Accurate device proportions.
